sentences.text: Heard on I.A. No. 23182 of 2023, first application under Section 389 (1) of Cr.P.C. for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail to the appellant.

This Criminal Appeal assails the judgment dated 15.12.2023 passed by Twelfth Additional Sessions Judge, Gwalior, District Gwalior (M.P.) in Sessions Trial No.588/2017, whereby appellant has been convicted and sentenced under Section 420/120-B of IPC to undergo rigorous imprisonment of four years with fine of Rs.1000/-, under Section 467/120-B of IPC to undergo rigorous imprisonment of four years with fine of Rs.5000/-, under Section 468/120-B of IPC to undergo rigorous imprisonment of three years with fine of Rs.1000/- and under Section 471/120-B of IPC to undergo rigorous imprisonment of four years with fine of Rs.5000/-, with default stipulations.

entities.text: Twelfth Additional Sessions Judge, Gwalior, District Gwalior (M.P.)
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the trial Court has wrongly convicted the appellant without appreciating the evidence available o n record.
There are material omissions and contradictions in the statement of the prosecution witnesses.

Complainant Pawan Sharma (PW-1)
has not supported the case of the prosecution and turned hostile.
It is further argued that appellant has ave already served around nineteen months of incarceration out of total jail sentence awarded.
The present criminal appeal is likely to take long time to conclude.
Hence, prayed to suspend the jail sentence and grant of bail to the appellant.
Counsel for the State vehemently opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the materials available on record.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, without commenting on merits of the case, I.A.
No.23182 of 2023 is hereby allowed.

Subject to depositing of fine amount, if not already deposited,
and on furnishing personal bond of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh only) with one solvent surety Laxman Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/140193562/
1 of the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned trial Court, the remaining jail sentence of appellant - Laxman Singh shall remain suspended and he be released on bail.
